text:
单页复验两页：
1. 第 1 页封面左下角原文「全开源 · Apache-2.0」改为「自研部分开源 · Apache-2.0」，请确认不溢出、不压到旁边「独立开发 · 2026」。
2. 第 12 页与上一版渲染有极小像素差（0.2%），请确认版式仍正常、无缺字/错位。

PNG：
/home/jinsc/SDK/vela/ppt/.build/render5/s-01.png
/home/jinsc/SDK/vela/ppt/.build/render5/s-12.png

每页一行 JSON：{"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":[],"fix":""}，最后一句说明。

thinking: Let me read the two assigned page images one by one and verdict each.

Page 1: The bottom-left footer reads 「自研部分开源 · Apache-2.0」— the edit is applied. Check: does it overflow or collide with 「独立开发 · 2026」? The left text ends around x≈395 (of 1999 width), and 「独立开发 · 2026」starts around x≈590. There's a clear gap between them, no overlap, no clipping. Both lines sit on the same baseline, well within the slide. Looks fine.

Watch image: the phone mockup on the right looks fine, no issues. The top header text is fine. Pass.

Now page 12.

Page 12: header "11 — 开源", title "整机自研，全栈开源", three columns with labels 自研 / 基于 / 可复现, each with divider line, content readable, no clipping, no overlap, page number "12 / 14" bottom-right. Text renders fully — no missing glyphs, no misalignment. There is a large empty band in the middle-lower area between the columns and the divider, but that's the existing design (sparse layout), and given this is a re-check of a 0.2% pixel diff, layout is intact. The large whitespace is arguably part of the design; not a new defect. Consistent with a minimal text deck. Pass.

The middle of the slide does have a fairly large empty region, but the layout reads intentional (three columns top, note block bottom). Given the check is only whether the layout remains normal with no missing/misplaced characters, it passes.

Output two JSON lines per requested format {"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":[],"fix":""}, then a final sentence.
